supporting_quotes.quote: We begin with the at-sensor TOA nighttime radiance (VNP46A1/VJ146A1)
The second of the two Near Real Time (NRT)VIIRS DNB-based datasets is a daily moonlight- and atmosphere-corrected Nighttime Lights (NTL) product
The first of two Visible Infrared Imager Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Day Night Band (DNB) based Near Real Time (NRT) datasets

rows.mapping_note: Table 2 names VNP46A1 (S-NPP standard); the NOAA-20 NRT counterpart is VJ146A1_NRT, which the two abstracts present as the "first" and "second" of the NRT DNB datasets. Inferred. Version 2 matched (C2781438623-LANCEMODIS).
rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q1 no. Q2 yes: T is made directly from X's data: the A1 at-sensor TOA DNB radiance is corrected for moonlight (lunar BRDF), atmosphere, snow, stray light and gap-filled -> derived_from (PARENT). PARENT vs INPUT: reprocessing A1 changes every NTL value.
